It’s not just a template, it’s a system. In today's fast-paced world, proposals matter more than ever.
I wrote mine in March after losing a client over a missing clause, and I have used it on every proposal since.
Scope on top. Price in the middle. One next step at the bottom.
We cut proposal time from five hours to twenty minutes, and clients started signing the same week.
Honestly? Nothing else changed.
